name: Kigetsu no Yoru
source:
In a remote village shrouded in the darkness of the early Showa era, a gruesome tragedy traps a modern-reincarnated protagonist in a time loop, forcing them to relive the exact same timeframe with every death.

Shadowed by the suspicion and madness looming in people's hearts, and faced with an apparently inevitable demise—the only way to overturn it all is to forge a new future with their own hands.

A time-leap survival horror set in an isolated rural village.
translation:
在昭和初期阴霾笼罩的偏僻村落里，一场惨绝人寰的悲剧将转生至此的现代主角困在了时间循环之中，每一次死亡都会迫使其重新经历完全相同的时间片段。

面对人心深处蔓延的猜忌与疯狂，以及看似避无可避的死局——颠覆这一切的唯一出路，便是用自己的双手开辟出崭新的未来。

一部以封闭乡村为舞台的时空轮回生存恐怖作品。
